gates.buildReason: Direct HTML/JavaScript application; no build step is required.

realEdge.environment: GitHub Actions windows-latest with Microsoft Edge, localhost readiness check, dedicated ephemeral user-data-dir, fake host planning bridge, IndexedDB inventory fixtures, and legacy localStorage sentinels
coverage: explicit business-ended gate before EOD proposal generation
next-workday service-demand estimate from forecast units/day multiplied by calendar days since last visit
0.25-day default reserve with configurable 0..1 reserveDays and ceil target rounding
vehicle stock subtraction and case-plus-loose conversion when evidence is complete
lower-bound demand produces minimum quantities only and never a formal recommended load
unknown demand, missing visit history, unknown/untracked vehicle stock, and uncovered visits force review paths
explicit machine-on-hand/capacity-not-considered policy, defensive copies, no legacy or analytics writes, and AN11B regression guard
